about.title: About the Battles of Legend: Monster Mayhem set
paragraphs: Battles of Legend: Monster Mayhem is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG special set released on 28 August 2025, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 177 cards, and with the 25 other rarities there are 202 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 177 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 202, adding the 25 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
